learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basic operating principles, components, and application areas of air conditioning systems.
Analyze psychrometric properties and moist air processes (heating, cooling, humidification, dehumidification) based on thermodynamic fundamentals.
Calculate the heating/cooling load for a space or building by considering indoor and outdoor design conditions.
Apply the design principles of air distribution systems (ducts, grilles, diffusers) and perform air flow rate calculations.
Select equipment used in air conditioning systems (compressor, evaporator, condenser, fan, filter, etc.) according to operating characteristics and system requirements.
Evaluate an air conditioning system in terms of energy efficiency, environmental impact, and economics; propose an appropriate system configuration.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to air conditioning, application areas, basic concepts, temperature and humidity concepts
Air temperature, Relative Humidity, Properties of humid air
Dry bulb temperature, wet bulb temperature
Split and package air conditioning systems
bibliography: İklimlendirme Esasları ve Uygulamaları, Recep Yamankaradeniz, İlhami Horuz, Salih Coşkun, Ö. Kaynaklı, N. Yamankaradeniz, Dora Yayıncılık, 2008
